notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-KISIN-MADAPUSIPERA-SHIN-22 by Claude Code, session cc-2aeb03; the extraction was written by Codex (codex-c83e7a, #1679 and #2151), with repairs by Claude Code (cc-fb70e5, #1830), and completed by Claude Code (cc-442dc5, #2154). The 41-page author PDF the extraction read (SHA-256 matching; Duke Math. J. 171 (2022), 1559–1614) was read in full on page images in five ranges against every item. Corrected in place: 53 item fields (38 statements, 15 locators) and 6 notes; ten items removed as not in the paper (L05 and N05, an isocrystal classification and a cone adapter the paper never states; C03–C10, the extraction's own quaternion counterexample chain for E8, now recorded in E8 itself); C02 kept as the corrected, quasi-split form of §1.3.15; 71 items added for definitions, constructions and cited inputs the proofs use, 7 of them planned; the briefs of routes 2–4 and the items of the source routes carry the confirmed corrections; prerequisites rebuilt as 30 cited works with DOIs or stable links. Statuses: all 25 library declarations opened at the pinned commits and all planned stages checked. Mistakes: of E1–E12, eleven are confirmed and E10 is rejected (the two formulas define the same group); E5 and E9 are revised from gaps to errors and E8 is rewritten, with a Shimura curve inside the paper's setting. 41 new claims were checked a second time, independently: 37 confirmed, 1 reclassified, 3 rejected; one was folded into E8, and the rest are E13–E49. The main new ones: Lemma 2.3.13 is false as stated, but the lift of Proposition 2.3.11 satisfies the missing condition (E41); Corollary 1.3.18 drops hypotheses of [KP18, Cor. 0.3] (E27); the proof of Proposition 1.3.10 needs the place induced by ι_p (E24); the proof of Proposition 1.1.13 misuses exactness of coinvariants (E17); G″ in §2.2.7 is not inside GSp(V″) (E32); gaps in §2.1.5 (E28), §2.2.7 (E34) and Corollary A.7 (E49). Theorems 1, 2 and 4–6 stand; Theorem 3 needs G quasi-split at p.
